name: @projexlight/sdk-event
summary: Conference + in-person event management: sessions, tickets, check-ins, capacity gates. Powers anything from a 50-person customer summit to a 5,000-attendee conference — composes with sdk-payment (ticket sales), sdk-notification (reminders), sdk-evidence (badge-scan proof), sdk-engagement (encounter per check-in).

endpoints.description: Fetch a session + capacity + registered count.
Check an attendee into a session (badge scan).

events.name: event.checkin.recorded.v1
events.description: Attendee checked in to a session; carries timestamp + badge-scan device.

events.name: event.capacity.full.v1
events.description: Session reached capacity; downstream waitlist + registration UIs react.

models.description: Per-session row: title, capacity, scheduled_start, location_id.
Per-ticket row: attendee_persona, session_id, kind (paid/comp/staff), payment_ref.

hooks.name: createSession
hooks.description: Create a session; capacity locked at creation, can be adjusted with an audit row.

hooks.name: issueTicket
hooks.description: Issue a ticket; idempotent on (attendee, session).

hooks.name: checkInAttendee
hooks.description: Record a check-in. Refuses on duplicate scan / wrong session.

hooks.name: getRoster
hooks.description: Return the attendee roster for a session with check-in status.

scenarios.title: Conference organizer creates the keynote session
scenarios.when_to_use: Pre-event setup. Create the session with capacity 500 + scheduled start.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Session row written; emits .session.created.v1. Sales page can start issuing tickets.

scenarios.title: Attendee pays → ticket issued
scenarios.when_to_use: Reactive on payment.succeeded.v1 — successful payment auto-issues the ticket + sends the QR confirmation.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Ticket row written + emitted. Confirmation email + QR code sent via sdk-notification.

scenarios.title: Staff scans badge at door → attendee checked in
scenarios.when_to_use: hdk-scanner scans the badge QR; we validate the ticket + record the check-in.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Check-in row written + emitted. Duplicate scan within EVENT_CHECKIN_DUPLICATE_GRACE_SEC is silently ignored (operator double-tap).

scenarios.title: Session hits capacity → waitlist + .capacity.full.v1
scenarios.when_to_use: 499 → 500 registrations; system emits .capacity.full.v1; subsequent issueTicket refuses + adds to waitlist.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Session flipped to waitlist-only; ticket sale page swaps button to 'Join waitlist'.

scenarios.title: Session host pulls the attendee roster
scenarios.when_to_use: Pre-session — host wants to know who registered + who checked in.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Roster returned; ordered by check-in time. Useful for the next session's drop-off analysis.

compliance_posture.notes: Ticket payments routed through sdk-payment (PCI-relevant logic stays there). Roster export is PII; gated by sdk-rebac persona checks. Check-in events traced to the scanning device for attestation chain.
